findings.frozenDecision: 北方华创 Research selection; not High-priority because strong realized localization earnings were paired with late_reversal price state, premium valuation and mixed peer asymmetry.
findings.label: late_reversal_correctly_blocked_at_base_horizon
findings.generalLesson: A strong structural thesis can remain correct long-term while being a poor immediate entry after a prior rerating. The 60d base horizon validates caution on the late-reversal state; the 120d recovery should not retroactively turn the original entry timing into a success.

findings.frozenDecision: 德业股份 Research selection only; no High-priority because all three PV-downstream peers were de-rated with strong realized engines and selected-vs-peer asymmetry was mixed.
findings.postOutcomeFundamentalDiagnosis: Deye fundamentals did not collapse: 2023Q1 revenue +147.88% and attributable profit +345.64%. Sungrow also accelerated sharply (+266.90% Q1 profit), while Ginlong profit grew +97.27%. The group remained fundamentally strong but the market preferred a different expression.
findings.label: mixed_asymmetry_correctly_not_promoted
findings.generalLesson: Fastest realized growth is not sufficient to choose the best stock. When several peers have valid engines and valuation/growth trade-offs are mixed, the Skill should remain Research rather than invent a winner.

findings.frozenDecision: Property financing reset promoted as High-priority hypothesis but No selection because policy relief was immediately rerated while developer profits/margins remained weak.
findings.label: policy_good_news_not_equal_buy_signal
findings.generalLesson: Balance-sheet/tail-risk policy support can be economically important without creating immediate equity alpha after a rapid rerating. Financing relief is not the same as a realized sales/margin earnings bridge.

findings.frozenDecision: Airline reopening promoted as High-priority hypothesis but No selection because airline stocks already anticipated reopening while Q3 earnings remained deeply negative.
findings.label: reopening_good_news_not_equal_buy_signal
findings.generalLesson: A durable policy catalyst should not be bought merely on confirmation when price has run ahead of unit-economics recovery.

lateReversalEvidence.baseOutcome: Research-only and strong 60d underperformance; 120d long-term recovery

expectationDurationEvidence.interpretation: Realized earnings remained strong but premium growth duration/intensity was overestimated.
Realized growth remained exceptional, but multiple strong peers existed and the highest-growth name was not the best stock expression.

crossWindowExpectationAbsorptionCheck.interpretation: The late-reversal/expectation-absorption warning now repeats across unrelated industries and supports keeping V1.1. The separate expectation-duration/quality-premium question is important but still not cleanly repeated enough to justify a new version.

decision.reason: V1.1 late-reversal discipline gained independent support, while the expectation-duration issue still lacks a sufficiently repeated, precisely defined failure class.
decision.nextAction: Continue unchanged V1.1 on another independent historical window with a different economic mix.

prohibitedUses: Do not alter V1.1 from this same-period run.
Do not use the 120d North Huachuang recovery to override the pre-registered 60d decision horizon.
Do not create a rule that highest earnings growth should win.
Do not learn fixed PE/growth/return thresholds from Deye/Sungrow or North Huachuang.
